title: Postdoctoral Fellowships at Uppsala University - 2027
field: Natural and technical sciences, biomedicine, biotechnology (interdisciplinary)
about: Three-year Novo Nordisk Foundation postdoctoral fellowship: two years at Uppsala University and a final year at a Danish institution. For researchers with a recent PhD in natural/technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology and a Danish connection. Call opened 30 September 2026.
requirements: PhD in natural and technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology within 5 years of the fellowship start date
Connection to Denmark (e.g. Danish degree, citizenship or several years of research at a Danish institution)
Host principal investigator at Uppsala University
card_alt: Card for Postdoctoral Fellowships at Uppsala University - 2027, offered by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, in Uppsala, Sweden, with a deadline of 29 Jan 2027. The photo is an aerial view of Stockholm's old town, Gamla Stan and Riddarholmen, with church spires, colourful rooftops and the waterfront.
